answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks through dynamic collateral bonds managed across a state-transition trellis. Nodes deposit financial collateral sealed under a time-release cipher, providing the economic timber required to back message validation. Attackers must commit verifiable, non-reusable capital lockups for every counterfeit node.
